settings.title: Settings
settings.themeDesc: Light, dark or follow your system.
settings.contrastDesc: Adjust the contrast of the M3E theme colors.
settings.languageDesc: Choose a language or automatically follow your system language.
settings.dynamicDesc: Automatically apply each service’s color while its tab is open.
settings.accentDesc: The M3E palette is generated from your chosen color. The active service color can override it.
settings.colorStyleDesc: How the chosen color is applied across the panel.
settings.refreshDesc: How often service data is fetched.
settings.showTipsDesc: Show usage guidance, including tips for dragging and organizing services on the overview page.
settings.notificationsDesc: Notify when a monitored service reports an issue or recovers. Off by default.
settings.notificationsPermissionDenied: Allow Floria SelfHub notifications in your system settings to receive alerts.
settings.systemIntegrationError: Could not update this system setting.
settings.startOnLoginDesc: Start Floria SelfHub minimized to the system tray when you sign in. Off by default.
settings.trayDesc: When enabled, closing the window keeps Floria SelfHub running in the tray. Use its menu to reopen or quit.
settings.aliasHint: Optional. Saved when you leave the field; clear it to remove.
settings.groupsDesc: Create categories and organize groups and services. Services are separated by group, in the same order as Home and the sidebar.
settings.groupExists: Enter a new name; this group already exists or the name is empty.
settings.moveServiceUp: Move service {name} up within its group
settings.moveServiceDown: Move service {name} down within its group
settings.exportDesc: Copies a JSON with your services and preferences, but without tokens, usernames or passwords. You will need to enter those credentials again after importing. Older files may still contain credentials; only import files you trust.
settings.importDesc: Paste a JSON exported from Floria SelfHub. Services are added to the existing ones and preferences are applied. Older files may contain credentials; only import files you trust.
settings.importInvalid: This is not a valid Floria SelfHub configuration.
settings.resetPrefsDesc: Back to your system language, auto theme, standard contrast, service colors, tips and minimize-to-tray on, notifications off and 30 s refresh. Your services are kept.
settings.removeAllDesc: Deletes every saved service and closes their tabs. Preferences are kept.
settings.aboutTagline: A private dashboard for monitoring your self-hosted services.
settings.aboutPrivacy: Services and preferences are stored on this device. In the desktop and iOS apps, tokens, usernames, and passwords are kept in the system credential store; on Android and in a browser, they remain in local storage without app-level encryption. These authentication fields are excluded from exports and are used for requests to your configured services. When Settings opens, the app queries GitHub's public API to check for updates.
settings.aboutUpdateCheckPrompt: Check whether a newer version is available.
settings.aboutUpToDate: You are using the latest version ({version}).
settings.aboutUpdateCheckFailed: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
settings.aboutReportIssueDesc: Help us identify and fix a problem
